Richard VanCleave. Tecarta offers many, many tools for one to explore the Bible on their own. I could easily write a chapter on that alone. However, the single most important thing to me is that I now have a well planned format for permanently storing my personal very objective thoughts with thumb markers where I have learned something very interesting from the Spirit of God speaking to my heart. Sometimes only a sentence, sometimes much more. Then as I have read through the Bible twice a years for about 30 years now, each of these thumb markers have my thoughts and comments through the many years. These thought and comments amazingly connect together in such preciseness that one would think that it was all written at the same time by someone who was a genius scholar. When actually I’m not, but have only done my imperfect best to journal what I see in my relationship-fellowship at that particular time and all together, it even surprises and baffles me. 
It gives me great pleasure to know that my great grand children can one day know me very well. I am 71 years old now and when I am 90+ years old I will publish it on line, so free of charge anyone can look up my thoughts on most of the scriptures throughout the Bible. I am praying that millions of others will start using Tecarta to journal their thoughts where they now can remember where to go back and find them. Most of our hand written notes are certain to be eventually lost or misplaced.
